allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Famed swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.

facts.overview: Famed swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.
facts.title: Cyrano de Bergerac

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Unable to confess his feelings directly, what indirect channel does Cyrano devise to reach Roxane's heart?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Brilliant swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac harbors a secret devotion to Roxane. Convinced his prominent nose makes him unlovable, he holds his tongue until discovering a roundabout path to voice his devotion.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Deliberate, heartfelt period romance balancing witty comedic energy with thoughtful emotional weight.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Jean-Paul Rappeneau balances grand period romance with sparkling verbal wit and ache, making this adaptation an emotionally resonant blend of lively humor and tender longing.
